name: motion-hold-cycle
title: Hold & Cycle
description: Vật vào, dừng lại cho người xem đọc nhưng vẫn phập phồng hay lắc nhẹ trong lúc dừng, rồi mới đi tiếp.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Action -> hold -> action, and the hold keeps a small cycle: recipe scale +-3 % on a 1000 ms sine during the hold. Demo: a star enters 0-0.6 s expo.out (x 30 -> 160), holds 0.6-2.4 s rocking +-0.06 rad on sin(8 t), exits 2.4-3.0 s expo.in to x 300. Params: amp (±3 %) · period (1 s) · hold: thời gian dừng. Action → hold → action: the hold keeps a small rock and pulse so the frame never goes dead.
